svg.title: inflation at most 2p. Multilinearity of the iterated derivatives bounds their sum by (2 2p)qb, which is at most (AB11) times b for q ≤j. This expansion follows by induction on the ordered list, using the exact left/right increment identity and the disjoint link supports of the positive and negative parts. Support enlargement is charged separately by its cover-number inequality; it is not included in this factor. At level i put xi = bβi and Mi = exp((log log xi)2). The normalizations used in (LCN1) are the calendar’s actual allowances
